'''Japanese curry''' is one of the oven meals. It heals {{Hp|20}} and grants {{EffectLink|Strength}} for 30 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/japanese_curry.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[curry stock]] cooks into Japanese curry in 15 seconds in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]]. Obtaining the stock unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 3 seconds, heals {{Hp|20}} and gives Strength I for 30:00. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].

== Advancements ==
* ''Hearty Curry'': make Japanese curry (1 [[obol]]).
